_note: Static content, bundled with the client. Picking a prompt creates an ordinary questions row authored by the picking player — there is no 'from library' flag anywhere in the data model. Written for a ROOM OF FRIENDS, not couples: the target is chosen at random from the group, so nothing here assumes a romantic partner. Spicy is bold and mortifying rather than explicit, which keeps §3's PG-13-by-default stance and app-store viability intact.
